description:
Get itemized individual contributions (Schedule A) — who donated to a committee, their employer and occupation, amount, and date.
This is the KEY tool for donor research: 'who funds this candidate and where do they work?'
The full dataset is ~123M records, so ALWAYS pass a filter — typically committee_id (the recipient committee) and/or contributor_name/employer.
WORKFLOW: (1) fec_search_committees or fec_search_candidates to find the committee_id, (2) this tool filtered by committee_id, optionally narrowing by contributor_employer (e.g. 'Goldman Sachs') or contributor_state.

committee_id.description: Recipient FEC committee ID (e.g. 'C00401224'). Get from fec_search_committees.

contributor_name.description: Donor name to filter by, e.g. 'Smith'

contributor_state.description: Two-letter state code of the donor

cycle.description: Two-year transaction period / election cycle (even year, e.g. 2024)

name: fec_individual_contributions
